scope: shipped learner, finite panel; oracle arm is an oracle-allocation diagnostic; cost estimation, not error certification

checks.name: the learner's `run` takes no world argument (it sees a sampler closure only)
every run is accounted for once as stopped or censored
every stop carries a positive certificate margin (statistic above threshold)
wrong answers among stopped runs are consistent with alpha
the truths are A on the base cells and B on the swapped cell
at the uniform design the active region changes between M = 16 and M = 64 (the transition is present in the panel): M = 16's argmin is not within 1% at M = 64
